title: Recruiter/ onboarder
description:
Nova oportunidade para Recruiter/ onboarder em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.   This is not your usual job post. Instead of the classic recruiter ad filled with words like "dynamic," "self-starter," and "people person," I thought I'd simply share the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Recruiter & Onboarder with Go! Running Tours.   Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one.   So, let's start.   Our new Recruiter/Onboarder will be responsible for finding, selecting, and onboard the incredible running guides who make Go! Running Tours what it is today.   You should get a kick out of owning the entire process from identifying candidates to bringing them to the finish line. We are not looking for quick fix recruiters, but for that one person who is able to recruit colleagues who will work with us for the next 5, 10, 15 years. Because truly good colleagues are hard to come by and even harder to let go.   In the team, we have everything from bike messengers to professors, from a young and fast 22-year-old, to an even faster retiree (sub 3 marathon type of retiree ). Your job will be to identify these candidates, bring them on board, and assist them in the early steps of their journey and ensure the quality of our tours.   The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skills of all are: execution and persistency (not the annoying type, but the type that brings you to the finish line of a marathon). And this is likely where the "ugly" comes in, because our colleagues have different backgrounds, different personalities and different lives outside Go! Running Tours. That means that some of our colleagues complete the onboarding and associated tasks without blinking and to perfection, while others may need more support and follow-up to reach the finish line.   You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that \"makes sense\" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world — and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!   Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!   We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for interviews and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.   The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.   The contract details are as follows:   Contract details are as follows:   10 hrs/week   USD 12/hr + bonus   Managed via upwork   That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.   If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the Chat GPT version ).   All the best and happy running,   Lena

description:

Based in São Paulo, Brazil | Full-time | Extensive regional travel Position Summary AV Flexologic B. V. is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its global Service & Support division, based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role provides on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair services for AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Central America. The successful candidate will work closely with the Service & Support coordination team (Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands) and the Monterrey and Bangkok offices to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across the region. Engagement structure This role is structured as an independent contractor engagement: the engineer will operate through their own Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ / "PJ" — pessoa jurídica) and issue a monthly invoice (nota fiscal) to AV Flexologic for services rendered, rather than being hired as a CLT employee. Key Responsibilities Perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and repair of AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites. Diagnose and resolve technical issues in the field, escalating to engineering or product specialists as needed. Travel regularly within the São Paulo area and across Brazil, as well as to Argentina, Chile, and Central America, for scheduled and emergency service visits. Provide clear, timely reporting on service visits, parts usage, and customer feedback to the Service & Support coordination team. Maintain professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders in Portuguese, Spanish, and English. Support training of local customer technicians where applicable. Maintain assigned company equipment (vehicle, tools, laptop, phone) in good working order. Travel Requirements This is a field-based, travel-intensive role. Expected travel coverage includes: São Paulo metropolitan area and state (base region, most frequent travel) Other regions of Brazil, as service demand requires Argentina and Chile Central America ("Middle America") Travel frequency will vary by season and customer install base; candidates should expect travel for a significant portion of working time, including multi-day international trips. A valid passport and the ability to obtain visas/work authorizations for the above countries is required. Candidate Requirements Technical degree or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or industrial engineering (or equivalent hands-on field service experience). Prior experience in field service, industrial equipment maintenance, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Fluent Portuguese (native/near-native) and working proficiency in English required; Spanish strongly preferred given Argentina/Chile/Central America coverage. Valid driver's license; comfortable with frequent independent travel. Strong troubleshooting mindset, customer service orientation, and ability to work autonomously in the field. Service Availability & Extra Hours Expected availability Equivalent to 40 hours per week Extra hours beyond scope Additional hours may be billed as an extra line item on the monthly invoice, or offset with reduced availability in a following period, as agreed between the parties. Downtime & Public Holidays Agreed annual downtime 20–25 business days per year with no invoice reduction, by mutual agreement (contractual, not statutory) National public holidays 9 fixed federal holidays, plus movable holidays (see list below) — no service expected, no invoice reduction Brazilian national (federal) holidays January 1 – New Year's Day April 21 – Tiradentes Day May 1 – Labour Day September 7 – Independence Day October 12 – Our Lady of Aparecida (Patron Saint of Brazil) November 2 – All Souls' Day November 15 – Republic Proclamation Day November 20 – National Black Consciousness Day (federal holiday since 2024) December 25 – Christmas Day In addition, Good Friday and Corpus Christi are movable, date-dependent observances, and Carnival (February/March) is technically an optional "ponto facultativo" day rather than a mandatory holiday — in practice, it is observed by the vast majority of Brazilian employers. State and municipal holidays (e.g., São Paulo city/state-specific dates) may add further non-working days depending on exact work location. On request holidays can be traded for work days in mutual agreement. Compensation (Monthly Invoice) Monthly invoice amount (indicative) Based on experience level Travel expenses Covered by AV Flexologic for company travel. Equipment Provided Company credit card for business/travel expenses Company mobile phone Company laptop Company vehicle — to be assessed based on actual travel patterns and territory size; if not provided, a vehicle/mileage allowance will apply for local travel

O seu desafio será pegar os roteiros criados pelo time de conteúdo e transformar isso em animações fluidas, dinâmicas e incrivelmente realistas usando as ferramentas de IA mais avançadas do mercado, somadas à sua bagagem de edição tradicional (Premiere/After Effects).   Se você é um entusiasta de tecnologias generativas, sabe dar ritmo para redes sociais e quer trabalhar em um projeto de impacto na educação, essa cadeira é sua.   O Perfil que buscamos   \"Early Adopter\" Criativo: Você está sempre testando a ferramenta de IA que lançou ontem. Entende de prompts, geração de imagem, lip-sync (sincronia labial) e animação de avatares. Senso de Realismo e Expressão: Sabe que animar IA não é só apertar um botão. Você tem o capricho de ajustar expressões faciais, movimentos corporais e a iluminação para que a persona não pareça robótica. Mestre do Ritmo (Retenção): Sabe que o Instagram exige dinamismo. Seus vídeos têm ganchos fortes nos primeiros 3 segundos, cortes precisos, sound design imersivo e elementos visuais que seguram a atenção. Autonomia Plena: Consegue pegar um briefing, resolver problemas técnicos de renderização ou geração de IA por conta própria e entregar o vídeo pronto para postar. O seu dia a dia (Responsabilidades)   Animação da Persona: Gerar e animar os vídeos da Maria de Fátima utilizando ferramentas de IA (como Hey Gen, D-ID, Runway, Pika, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, ou similares). Edição Dinâmica para Reels/Tik Tok: Finalizar os vídeos gerados pela IA no Premiere/After Effects, inserindo legendas dinâmicas, motion graphics de apoio, memes e elementos que conversem com o público jovem e educacional. Sound Design e Sincronia: Garantir que a voz gerada por IA tenha a entonação correta, com sincronia labial perfeita, e mixar trilhas e efeitos sonoros que deem \"alma\" ao vídeo. Interface Criativa: Trabalhar lado a lado com os analistas de conteúdo para entender o objetivo do roteiro e sugerir as melhores saídas visuais e prompts para cada postagem. Pré-requisitos   Experiência comprovada (Portfólio) em edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (Reels/Tik Tok). Domínio prático obrigatório em ferramentas de geração e animação por Inteligência Artificial (vídeo, imagem e voz). Domínio avançado do Pacote Adobe (especialmente Premiere Pro e After Effects). Excelente senso estético, de ritmo de edição e aplicação de trilhas sonoras. Capacidade de otimizar tempo: saber quando usar a IA para acelerar o processo e quando usar a edição manual para refinar o detalhe. Diferenciais   Experiência prévia trabalhando com avatares virtuais, influenciadores digitais gerados por computador ou projetos de tecnologia/inovação. Noções de Prompt Engineering avançado (saber conversar com as IAs para extrair o resultado exato do briefing). title: Client success manager (smma)
description:
Empresa está contratando Client success manager (smma) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Client Success Manager — 2 URN Marketing   Location: Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: COO Comp: $2,000 + $ bonuses tied to retention & client results and revneu share (3% of renewals + 10% Upsells)   Read this part first   Most agencies hand a roofer a login and a monthly report and call it service. We don't do that. We come into roofing companies internally and build — the funnel, the CRM, the follow-up, the reporting, the process their office actually runs on. Our clients don't buy leads from us. They buy a lead engine we install and then operate alongside their team.   That means this is not a check-in-and-take-notes job. You are the person inside the client's business making the machine work. If you like owning outcomes and hate babysitting inboxes, keep reading.   What you'll actually own   You'll carry a book of roofing contractor accounts from signed contract through their entire life with us.   Launch (first 24–72 hours after a client signs)   Run the onboarding call and pull everything the build needs: service area, offer, pricing, photos, reviews, brand assets, calendar availability. Stand up their Go High Level sub-account: pipeline, calendar, lead-intake workflows, SMS + email follow-up, call routing. Get their landing page live and their form wired to the CRM — then test it yourself by submitting a real lead and watching it land. Confirm tracking fires end to end before a dollar of ad spend goes out. We launch clients in days, not weeks. That deadline is yours to hold.   Ongoing (where the job really lives)   Watch every account's numbers daily: leads, cost per lead, show rate, booked inspections, closed jobs. Know which of your accounts is drifting before the client does. Run weekly and monthly client calls. Walk them through what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing — in plain English, not ad-platform jargon. Be the bridge to the media buyer and creative team. When CPL climbs or leads stop booking, you diagnose whether it's ads, the offer, the follow-up, or the client's own sales process — and you route it to the right person with the data attached. Coach the client's office staff on speed-to-lead and follow-up. Half of a bad month is a roofer who isn't calling leads back in five minutes. Your job is to say that out loud, kindly, with the call logs to prove it. Keep every account's notes, action items, and next steps current in the CRM and in Click Up. If it isn't written down, it didn't happen. Spot expansion honestly: more markets, more spend, add-on programs — but only when the core engine is already producing. Retention   Own renewal and churn risk for your book. You should know which client is unhappy two weeks before they tell you. Run save conversations yourself. Bring the numbers, own what we got wrong, and come with a fix, not an apology. What we measure you on   Client retention and length of stay On-time launches (live inside the promised window) Account health: leads delivered, CPL against target, show rate, booked jobs Speed of response to client issues CRM/Click Up hygiene — notes, action items, and reporting actually current Who this is for   2+ years in account management, client success, or agency service — or you've run operations inside a home-services company and know the trade from inside. Comfortable in a CRM every single day. We run Go High Level — if you know it, say so loudly in your application. If you don't, you need to be the kind of person who'll learn a platform cold in two weeks. You can read an ad account report and tell a story with it. You don't need to be a media buyer, but you must know what cost per lead, show rate, and cost per booked job mean and what makes each one move. Direct communicator. Our clients are roofing owners and GMs. They want straight answers, not marketing vocabulary. Organized without being reminded. You'll juggle a dozen accounts, each with its own build state, spend level, and open items. Thick skin and a spine. Sometimes the honest answer is \"your team isn't calling the leads.\" You have to be able to say it. Bonus points for: home services / roofing / construction background, Meta Ads Manager familiarity, funnel building, Click Up, experience owning a renewal number.   What you get   A real book of business and the authority to actually fix things, not just escalate them. Direct access to the founder and the build team — no layers. A company that already has the delivery figured out: 26+ roofing clients served and 14,676 leads generated to date, backed by a 100,000-dollars-in- signed-jobs-in-90-days guarantee. You're not selling a promise; you're operating something that works. Unlimited PTO / Learning Oppertunities
